title.zh: 面向 iOS 的光照贴图优化

subtitle.en: Getting RGBM lightmaps onto iOS: ETC2 instead of DXT5, why planar mode barely won, and how vertex baking cut lightmap memory to a quarter.
subtitle.zh: 把 RGBM 光照贴图搬到 iOS 上：用 ETC2 取代 DXT5、planar mode 为什么几乎没胜出，以及顶点烘焙如何把光照贴图内存压到四分之一。

translator.note: 纹理格式名（DXT5-RGBM、ETC1、ETC2、PVR）、模式名（planar mode、T/H 模式）与算法名（least squares fitting、least squares vertex baking）按术语表保留英文；`texel` 作「纹素」，`chart` 作「图块」，`hemicube` 作「半立方体」。原文两处代码围栏里是内存数据本身，逐字保留，未加中文注释；中文说明放在 captionZh。文中插图按全站口径保留原图 URL（首图与 `charts.png`、`etc-rgbm-chart-2.png`），三张小图原为项目符号列表项，归一化为独立图片段落。

blocks.en: One of the main challenges of porting The Witness to iOS was reducing the app memory footprint. The lightmaps that we used in the PC version simply did not fit in the memory budget that we had for iOS.
blocks.zh: 把《The Witness》移植到 iOS 时，主要的挑战之一就是降低应用的内存占用。我们在 PC 版里用的那些光照贴图，根本放不进 iOS 上的内存预算。

blocks.en: As described in my [previous article](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2016/09/lightmap-compression-in-the-witness/), on PC we compress our lightmaps using DXT5-RGBM. The DXT5 texture compression format is not available in iOS, so the first problem was to find a suitable alternative.
blocks.zh: 正如我在[上一篇文章](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2016/09/lightmap-compression-in-the-witness/)里描述的，在 PC 上我们用 DXT5-RGBM 压缩光照贴图。DXT5 这种纹理压缩格式在 iOS 上不可用，所以第一个问题是找到一个合适的替代方案。

blocks.en: PVR is the most popular texture compression format on iOS, but it was not a particularly good choice. It has some annoying size constrains and doesn’t support an independent alpha channel; using a RGBM scheme would require sampling multiple textures.
blocks.zh: PVR 是 iOS 上最流行的纹理压缩格式，但它并不是特别好的选择。它有一些烦人的尺寸限制，也不支持独立的 alpha 通道；要用 RGBM 方案就得采样多张纹理。

blocks.en: Since we require metal for rendering, all the devices we care about also support ETC2, which has a mode analogous to DXT5 with one block representing the RGB colors and another block representing the alpha. This was a much better fit for our RGBM lightmap representation.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的渲染要求使用 Metal，我们关心的所有设备也都支持 ETC2：它有一种模式类似 DXT5，一个块表示 RGB 颜色，另一个块表示 alpha。这对我们的 RGBM 光照贴图表示来说合适得多。

blocks.en: For the RGB components I simply used Rich Geldreich’s ETC compressor ([rg-etc1](https://github.com/richgel999/rg-etc1)). This only supports ETC1 block mode, without the ETC2 extensions. Lightmaps are often fairly smooth, and I was hoping ETC2’s planar mode would be very effective at representing them. I wrote a nearly optimal planar compressor using least squares fitting, but interestingly the standard ETC1 mode was able to achieve lower errors in most cases, only 4% of the blocks ended up using the planar mode.
blocks.zh: RGB 分量我直接用了 Rich Geldreich 的 ETC 压缩器（[rg-etc1](https://github.com/richgel999/rg-etc1)）。它只支持 ETC1 块模式，没有 ETC2 的那些扩展。光照贴图往往相当平滑，我本希望 ETC2 的 planar mode 在表示它们时非常有效。我用 least squares fitting 写了一个近乎最优的 planar 压缩器，但有意思的是，在大多数情况下标准 ETC1 模式反而能得到更低的误差，最终只有 4% 的块用了 planar mode。

blocks.en: As you can see in this graph, the quality of ETC2-RGBM is slightly lower than DXT5-RGBM, but in practice it’s almost impossible to appreciate any difference despite the higher error. Adding support for T and H modes may help reduce the gap between DXT5-RGBM and ETC2-RGBM, but it did not seem worth the effort and I had more important issues to address.
blocks.zh: 从这张图里可以看到，ETC2-RGBM 的质量略低于 DXT5-RGBM，但误差虽然更高，实际中几乎没人能看出差别。支持 T 模式和 H 模式也许有助于缩小 DXT5-RGBM 与 ETC2-RGBM 之间的差距，但这看起来不值得费那个劲，我还有更重要的问题要处理。

blocks.en: With these changes the size of the lightmaps on mobile was now the same as on PC, but our goal was to reduce it further. One of the simplest solutions is to simply reduce the resolution of the lightmaps. This works to some extent, but due to inefficiencies in lightmap packing, the size of the lightmaps is not directly proportional to the resolution. The lower the resolution, the higher these inefficiencies, so this approach alone provides diminishing returns. For example, in the image below the lightmap area on the right side is one quarter of the left, but the number of texels is only halved.
blocks.zh: 经过这些改动，移动端光照贴图的体积已经和 PC 上一样了，但我们的目标是进一步压缩它。最简单的做法之一就是直接降低光照贴图的分辨率。这在一定程度上有效，但由于光照贴图排布中的低效，它的体积并不与分辨率直接成正比。分辨率越低，这些低效就越严重，所以光靠这个办法收益是递减的。比如说，下面这张图里右侧的光照贴图面积是左侧的四分之一，但纹素数量只减了一半。

blocks.en: To overcome that we used a slightly more aggressive packing scheme, but the most effective approach was to use per-vertex lightmaps computed using [least squares vertex baking](http://www.jarmilakavanova.cz/ladislav/papers/vb-egsr11/vb-egsr11.htm).
blocks.zh: 为了克服这一点，我们用了稍微更激进的排布方案，但最有效的做法是使用通过 [least squares vertex baking](http://www.jarmilakavanova.cz/ladislav/papers/vb-egsr11/vb-egsr11.htm) 计算出来的逐顶点光照贴图。

blocks.en: Least squares vertex baking was specially effective on small meshes that are instanced numerous times, such as pebbles and small rocks. However, it also introduced some new problems.
blocks.zh: least squares vertex baking 在被大量实例化的小网格上特别有效，比如小石子和碎石。不过它也带来了一些新问题。

blocks.en: In [one of my first articles about the lightmap tech of The Witness](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/articles/hemicube-rendering-and-integration/) I described the method used to identify invalid samples: when rendering hemicubes I counted the number of back facing texels. When that number was above a certain threshold the sample was considered invalid and its color would be extrapolated by the surrounding samples instead. This worked well, but the threshold we used was somewhat conservative, because many of our meshes were not perfectly watertight or not correctly closed. This resulted in some false positives, that is, some invalid samples were considered valid. This was generally not a problem, because these samples were usually not visible from the player point of view, but hidden behind other geometry (for example, under the ground). However, when using least squares vertex baking, the contribution of these samples would influence the vertices of the triangle it belonged to, and often these vertices were visible by the player.
blocks.zh: 在我[最早几篇讲《The Witness》光照贴图技术的文章](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/articles/hemicube-rendering-and-integration/)之一里，我描述过识别无效采样的方法：渲染半立方体的时候，我统计背向纹素的数量。当这个数量超过某个阈值时，该采样就被视为无效，它的颜色改由周围的采样外推得到。这个方法效果不错，但我们用的阈值偏保守，因为我们的很多网格并非完全密闭、或者没有正确封闭。这导致了一些假阳性，也就是说，一些无效采样被当成了有效。这一般不是问题，因为这些采样通常从玩家视角看不到，而是被其他几何体挡住（比如地面之下）。然而，使用 least squares vertex baking 时，这些采样的贡献会影响到它所属三角形的顶点，而这些顶点往往是玩家能看到的。

blocks.en: The only solution that I could come up with was to tighten the validation threshold, but this resulted in many new artifacts resulting from sloppy geometry, that then had to be cleaned up, consuming valuable artist time.
blocks.zh: 我能想出的唯一办法就是把验证阈值收得更紧，但这又因为粗糙的几何体而带来许多新的瑕疵，这些瑕疵随后还得清理，消耗了宝贵的美术时间。

blocks.en: Despite the extra work, I think the results justified the effort. At the most expensive location, the lightmap memory use was reduced to a 25% of the original:
blocks.zh: 尽管多了这些额外工作，我认为结果是值得的。在最吃内存的那个场景位置，光照贴图的内存占用被压到了原来的 25%：

blocks.zh: 而在可分发的安装包里，光照贴图资源更是被压到了仅仅 17%：
